subject: Invoice #GZ-2026-1187 for your GTA VI pre-order

body: This week: a roundup of new small open-weight models, a comparison of agent frameworks and a tutorial on structured outputs with Pydantic.

body: Dude, the new trailer is insane, the city looks so real. Watch it and tell me what you think. Also, how is your AI course going? Still learning Python?

subject: Last chance: 50% off the AI Engineer course
body: Our AI Engineer course with RAG, agents and fine-tuning modules is 50% off until midnight. Don't miss it!

subject: Can you help me with my CV?
body: Hey, I'm applying for a junior backend role next week. Could you look at my CV and GitHub on Sunday? I'll buy you a coffee :)

Reminder: GTA VI release party

subject: 1:1 meeting on Monday
body: Let's have our regular 1:1 on Monday at 11:00. I'd like to talk about your goals for next quarter and your interest in the AI team.

subject: Sprint planning moved to Thursday 10:00
body: Sprint planning is moved from Wednesday to Thursday at 10:00 because half of the team is at a conference. Please estimate your tickets in Jira before the meeting.

subject: Your vacation request has been approved

subject: Your password expires in 2 days
